name: @nite07/search-workspace
description: Shared search engine, DSH plugin and MCP server workspace

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nite07/search-core && npm run build -w @nite07/dsh-search && npm run build -w @nite07/websearch-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nite07/search-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:workspace
